video_title: Is Expansion Good For The NBA? + Is It Coming Soon?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver's upcoming challenges regarding the Los Angeles Lakers sale
quotes.excerpt: Adam Silver has a few things to deal with over these NBA owners' meetings.
quotes.quote: Adam Silver has a few things to deal with over these NBA owners' meetings. First off, we have this Lakers sale. We want to hear what the league has to say about that, about Mark Walter flipping it, about Mark Walter potentially having these financial problems. It was reported at the end of last week that Mark Walter was selling his 13% stake in Chelsea Football Club in London. You are selling these things for a reason.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA has not officially committed to expansion plans
quotes.excerpt: They have not actually said they are going to expand.
quotes.quote: They have not actually said they are going to expand. I know that everybody is making assumptions and they have had their bankers take bids and everything, but they have not actually said we are for sure going to expand. And they have not said we are for sure going to expand to Vegas and Seattle, and they have not said whether they are going to expand to Vegas and Seattle at the same time.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA owners are budgeting for massive expansion fees
quotes.excerpt: They are budgeting getting between five and 600 million dollars in expansion fees.
quotes.quote: I talked to an owner recently who told me that they are budgeting getting between five and 600 million dollars in expansion fees, which means they believe that the two teams will generate between 15 and 18 billion dollars in sale. It sounded to me like that owner was going to be voting for expansion if he was already counting his money.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Expansion bids for Las Vegas exceed eight billion dollars
quotes.excerpt: The bids for the Las Vegas team were all over eight billion dollars.
quotes.quote: From what I understand, the bids for the Las Vegas team were all over eight billion dollars. They got multiple bids over eight billion dollars, and so that means it is going to go higher than that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst's personal history with the Cleveland Browns relocation
quotes.excerpt: When I was 17 years old living in Akron, Ohio, the Cleveland Browns relocated to Baltimore.
quotes.quote: When I was 17 years old living in Akron, Ohio, the Cleveland Browns relocated to Baltimore. They have since won multiple Super Bowls, that franchise has won multiple Super Bowls, and the Browns have been horrendous. It was devastating. I went to the second to last home game. It was a devastating, devastating thing.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Concerns regarding the financial health of current NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: I have seen some of the books of the NBA teams and I am not sure.
quotes.quote: I have seen some of the books of the NBA teams and I am not sure that there are 30 healthy teams. We are living in a world where there are not 30 healthy financial teams and we are seeing every couple of years the NBA have to put in tanking rules because you have teams who realize they do not want to be in the middle.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Revenue sharing is necessary for the NBA's 30-team model
quotes.excerpt: Otherwise they would not have revenue sharing.
quotes.quote: Otherwise they would not have revenue sharing. At some point you have to make a decision, do you want a 10-team league where everybody is filthy rich or do you want a 30 or 32-team league where there are teams in Milwaukee and Cleveland and Minneapolis and Oklahoma City? The answer is they want the latter.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Fulham FC's small but dedicated local fan base
quotes.excerpt: Fulham is this small London club. They were telling me that they believe that they have 18,000 fans.
quotes.quote: Fulham is this small London club. It is worth a billion pounds. They were telling me that they believe that they have 18,000 fans that live in London. 18,000. That is what they believe their fan base is. 15 to 18,000 people. Their worldwide fan base is huge and they sell out every game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Nancy Walton Laurie is a top bidder for Vegas expansion
quotes.excerpt: The one that I would keep an eye on is the Nancy Walton Laurie.
quotes.quote: The one that I would keep an eye on is the Nancy Walton Laurie. Her and her husband are believed to be one of the bidders for Las Vegas.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Walton family's growing interest in professional sports ownership
quotes.excerpt: The Walton family has been getting more and more interested in pro sports ownership.
quotes.quote: The Walton family has been getting more and more interested in pro sports ownership. Rob Walton bought the Broncos a couple of years ago. Lucas Walton and his wife, who is the grandson of Sam Walton, bought 10% of the Chicago Bulls. Nancy Walton Laurie is bidding for the Vegas team. Nancy Walton's sister, Anne Walton, married a gentleman by the name of Stan Kroenke. So, Nancy Walton's brother-in-law is Stan Kroenke, who owns the Denver Nuggets, Los Angeles Rams, Arsenal Football Club, and most recently the Anaheim Angels, Colorado Avalanche.
